in_sanskrit.name: Kehar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Vishnu's icon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kehar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Kehar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kshetra', meaning 'field' or 'body'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted as having a 'Khechar' or 'icon' in his hands, representing the preservation and protection of the universe. This name is therefore considered to be a reverence to Lord Vishnu and a symbol of divine protection.
